# 瞬态性能与加减速

_Transient Performance & Acceleration_

瞬态过程连接一个工作状态与另一个工作状态，不能仅由两个稳态点的差值解释。阅读时应同时追踪转子惯性、部件工作点变化、控制作用与限制条件。

_A transient connects operating states and cannot be explained only by subtracting two steady-state points. Follow rotor inertia, changing component operating points, control action and limits together._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先注明起点、终点、输入变化和响应时间的定义。

_Specify initial and final states, input changes and the definition of response time._

- 将转速、温度、压力和稳定裕度等响应放到同一时间轴上比较。

_Compare speed, temperature, pressure and stability-margin responses on a common time axis._

- 使用 C-MAPSS40k 等公开模型时，核对其工况范围与动态假设。

_Check the operating range and dynamic assumptions of public models such as C-MAPSS40k._

参考书主题对应：第 8 章。下文是本站导读，章节关联用于定位原书。
